note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Directory.Read.All, Directory.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, User.Read.All, TeamSettings.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# 1. note the current expiration policy so teardown can put it back
# 2. two extra Microsoft 365 groups owned by Alex; Temp Project Kickoff is deleted (restore target)

foreach ($d in 'Contoso Book Club', 'Temp Project Kickoff') { if (-not (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$d'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = $d; mailNickname = ($d -replace '\W', '').ToLower(); mailEnabled = $true; securityEnabled = $false; groupTypes = @('Unified'); 'owners@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$alex") } | Out-Null } }

$k = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'Temp Project Kickoff'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if ($k) { Set-LabVar MG_KICKOFF_ID $k.id; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($k.id)" }
# 3. local copies of lifecycle.json (Selected and the All variant for the rollout preview)

$all = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=groupTypes/any(c:c eq 'Unified')&`$select=id,displayName&`$top=999").value; $ids = @($all | Where-Object { $_.displayName -match '^(TEAM_.*_)?(Project Falcon|Old Offsite 2024|Sales Partner Portal|Budget 2027)$' } | ForEach-Object id)

$p = Get-Content ./src/lifecycle.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $p.expiration.selectedGroupIds = $ids; $p.expiration.alternateNotificationEmails = @($env:MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN); $p | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/lifecycle.lab.json; $p.expiration.managedGroupTypes = 'All'; $p | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/lifecycle.all.lab.json

foreach ($n in 'Contoso Book Club', 'Temp Project Kickoff') { foreach ($x in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$n'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($x.id)" } }
